name: How much does it cost to remove roots from a sewer line?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to remove roots from a sewer line?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of root removal varies significantly based on several factors, including the extent of the root invasion, the length and accessibility of the affected pipe, and the method required (e.g., hydro-jetting vs. auger). Minor root intrusions might be less costly than severe blockages requiring extensive work or pipe repair. It's crucial to get an inspection to accurately assess the situation. CG Plumbing Solutions provides detailed quotes after a thorough assessment, ensuring you understand the scope of work and associated costs before any service begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost varies depending on root severity, pipe accessibility, and removal method. An inspection is needed for an accurate quote.
